title: Benchmark’s Commodity Updates: Cobalt and Phosphate
gist: The text is a member-only video listing page, not a transcript: it carries only a one-line description of Adam Webb's 28-minute Giga Africa 2026 market update on cobalt and phosphate, plus blurbs for sibling sessions. No prices, balances or forecasts are disclosed.

themes.theme: Cobalt and phosphate as Africa-relevant battery inputs

insights.claim: Benchmark singled out cobalt and phosphate as the battery raw materials for its commodity update at an Africa-focused conference, pairing the DRC-centred cobalt market with the phosphate feedstock behind LFP chemistry.
insights.speaker: Adam Webb, Head of Battery Raw Materials, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Benchmark's choice of commodities signals where it sees Africa's battery-materials leverage: cobalt (DRC) and phosphate (Morocco-linked LFP feedstock).
insights.quote: Benchmark-led presentations providing the latest market updates and insights on key battery raw materials, including Cobalt and Phosphate.
insights.locator: Benchmark’s Commodity Updates: Cobalt and Phosphate

themes.theme: Conference agenda: midstream, policy and finance

insights.claim: The surrounding Giga Africa 2026 agenda paired the commodity update with sessions on a Western-aligned DRC midstream corridor, U.S. onshoring and financing, rare earths and the Lobito Corridor, showing supply-chain security framing dominates the event.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Minerals
insights.so_what: Africa battery-metals discourse is now framed through Western supply-chain security rather than pure market fundamentals.
insights.quote: Fireside Chat: Strategic Materials Security: Building a Western-Aligned Midstream Corridor from the DRC

insights.claim: A related session focuses on technologies to improve energy efficiency, sustainability and long-term operating costs in project design.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Minerals
insights.so_what: Opex and sustainability engineering is being positioned as a competitiveness lever for African projects.
insights.quote: Exploring emerging technologies and innovations to improve energy efficiency, sustainability, and long-term operating costs.
insights.locator: Panel Discussion: Innovations in Technology and Project Design

source_meta.author: Adam Webb , Head of Battery Raw Materials , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
